premises.text: Global water stress leads to billions of people depending on less clean water.
premises.evidence_span: we live in an age of global water stress. Billions of people are dependent on less and less clean water.

premises.text: Traditional showers waste a significant amount of water and energy.
premises.evidence_span: we waste 150 trillion liters of fresh, hot drinking water every year. And that's enough to fill a 20-meter tube to the moon.

premises.text: Current solutions to water waste in showers are ineffective.
premises.evidence_span: the traditional response has been to restrict the flow and use less water. But what do people do when their comfort drops? They shower for longer.

premises.text: The e-shower can save about 80% on energy and about 90% on water.
premises.evidence_span: the Hemel's e-shower uses every precious drop not once, but about seven times. And by doing that, we save about 80% on energy and about 90% on water.

premises.text: The e-shower is easy to install and can be connected to devices.
premises.evidence_span: it's plug and play. So, it's easy to install, and you can take it away easily. It's connected to your devices, so you can stream some music or check your savings on your phone.

premises.text: Big brands are supporting the e-shower due to its potential to disrupt sanitation and construction.
premises.evidence_span: big brand hotels, big brand construction companies are supporting us, and they've given us either bought prototypes or given us letters of intent for thousands of showers.

premises.text: The e-shower significantly reduces infrastructure needs for water systems.
premises.evidence_span: with our shower, you don't need big water systems anymore. So your boiler goes from 200 liters for a family to 20 liters.

value.text: The e-shower provides a sustainable solution for water and energy use in households.
value.evidence_span: we make sustainable homes available for everyone at very little cost.

notes: No separate premises for installation and connectivity as they are part of the same offering.
